rationale: ROUND 2 on 7e3dd082 — every objection was verified at the code or the live rows before answering; two changed the code, the rest are answered with evidence the first round should have carried. (1) reuse_agent HIGH (the fourth-identity-store fear): VERIFIED INVERTED. The three-stores landmine's own measurement says sites.email 'is where the owner's data actually goes' (12 of 15 real sites), and the bugs 072 fix is IN THE CODE TODAY: plan_sections' sourceResolver resolves identity.email → sites.email (plan_sections_action.go:758 doc, :810 resolved_from="sites."+col). Writing sites.email/company_name therefore writes the CANONICAL store the resolver reads; seeding aspect='identity' here would RECREATE the two-disagreeing-stores state the landmine documents, and the pipeline's own domain-research-classifier writes identity later in the same build with these columns as ground truth. The decision and its grounds are now IN the helper's doc comment. (2) reuse/guardian/constitution MEDIUM (use write_site_spec): VERIFIED UNSAFE FOR THIS CASE, now stated in code: WriteSiteSpecAction manages its OWN transaction (site_spec_actions.go:210 BeginTx) — this write must be atomic with the first work item's insert; and siteSpecDeepMerge OVERWRITES arrays (site_spec_actions.go:553-554, the non-map arm) — merging a two-fact seed over an enriched register would REPLACE its facts wholesale, the exact clobber the WHERE NOT EXISTS prevents. The typed round-trip alternative is the LANDMINES:8216 trap ('parsing evidence_base through its own typed struct and writing it back DELETES every citation'). The INSERT now mirrors the canonical writer's column shape exactly (source, source_agent, created_by, notes, is_current) so readers see one shape — the reuse concern honored at the seam that is safe to share. (3) guardian's caller enumeration: EXACTLY ONE live workflow invokes seed_build_queue — build-pipeline-trigger (agent_definitions LIKE query over active, non-snapshot rows, 2026-08-31); blast radius is that one trigger's entries whose direction carries the intake keys. (4) guardian's consumer-compatibility ask: CONFIRMED at the live consumer — validate_page_content.loadEvidenceBase returns nil for absent registers ('the claims layer is opt-in per site') and parses mine through ParseEvidenceBase; kind='entity' is in the recognised vocabulary (the bugs 105 warn-arm names only unrecognised kinds); unknown FIELDS are not rejected. (5) prior_art MEDIUM (absence claims cited from prose): NOW VERIFIED AT CODE — upsertSite inserts exactly (domain, name, network_id, status) with no email/company_name path (site_db_actions.go:1107-1118, read this round); and a content search for other writers of aspect='evidence_base' finds exactly two besides write_site_spec — evidence_citations.go:375 (research flow) and refresh_evidence_base_action.go:1423 (the scheduled refresher, which operates on EXISTING registers) — neither runs at site creation, so this is the only seed-time arming path. (6) debug_historian MEDIUM (661 header's ancestry gate is the documented anti-pattern): FIXED — the header now instructs the per-service running-binary probe (grep /proc/1/exe for the seedCustomerIdentity symbol, plus an absent-symbol control), not a git ancestry check. (7) compliance's verified_at concern: FIXED IN CODE — both seeded facts now carry verification_status:'customer_attested' so no downstream reader can mistake a customer's say-so for platform verification; verified_at stays for shape parity with the live register's owner-attested facts. Tests updated (the payload matcher now requires the customer_attested marker) and all three original mutations still kill their tests.
